data.one_liner: A Material Design 3 carousel implementation for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter implementation of the Material Design 3 carousel component, supporting hero, contained, and uncontained layouts. It offers horizontal and vertical scrolling, custom alignment, and theme extensions for customization.
use_when: You need Material Design 3 compliant carousels in your Flutter application.
You want to display hero, contained, or uncontained carousel layouts with configurable axes.
avoid_when: Your project cannot use the material_ui package dependency.
You need simple standard page views or list views without M3 carousel specifications.
strengths: Supports multiple M3 carousel types (hero, contained, uncontained, fullScreen).
Allows horizontal or vertical scrolling directions.
weaknesses: Requires the material_ui package instead of standard package:flutter/material.dart imports.
Strict Dart and Flutter version constraints.
data.setup_notes: Add material_ui and m3_carousel to your pubspec.yaml and replace standard material imports with material_ui.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides foundational UI components and material themes.
